headline: Ratchet & Clank removes assisted pseudo-functions while adding movie and level C
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 61.16% to 61.22% matched code, while its reported finished-function count falls from 3,717 to 3,706. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The day reverts pseudo-functions using fixed register choices or inline assembly, adds ordinary-C movie functions, and lands four object routines in Rilgar, Pokitaru, Gemlik and shared code (#45).
highlights: The change in coverage and function count measures different things: coverage is weighted by code size, while reverted pseudo-functions reduce the count.
#45 reports exact checks for its additions but still notes one non-exact executable function in the wider build.
